verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's integrated authenticator documents automatic TOTP generation (six-digit, SHA-1, 30-second rotation), and its Authenticator documents QR-code scanning, but only for importing a Google Authenticator export, not for scanning a new account's setup QR. One community user's vague report of never getting TOTP working is not concrete enough to dispute the documented capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scanning a new account's setup QR code, hands-on corroboration of the scan-to-code flow.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs), six-digit codes using SHA-1 that rotate every 30 seconds
Google Authenticator (QR code): Import from Google Authenticator using a QR code
